resources.string: Who do you want to send kudos to today?
Community Standards are established to ensure a civilized, safe, and positive environment for all members participating in the Sun* Kudos recognition and appreciation movement.
Content detected to violate one of the criteria below will be labeled as Spam and proactively hidden by the system.
Using profanity, insults, or content that is offensive or defamatory.
Mentioning political, religious, or gender-discriminatory issues.
Containing specific figures (revenue, contracts, KPIs, clients, project codes, account numbers, etc.).
Mentioning names of partners, clients, or external organizations.
Containing personal information (email, phone number, address, family details).
Sending 3 or more messages with similar content repeatedly in a short period.
Kudos content that is too short (under 30 characters) or lacks context (e.g. \"Thanks a lot\", \"Thanks!\", \"Good job!\").
Sending to too many people/groups in a short period (<3s per message).
Spam language (containing only characters such as \"!\", \".\", \"...\", or characters without meaningful content).
An abnormally sudden spike in \"hearts\" (based on average user behavior).
Sunners commit to protecting information. All members are responsible for keeping shared content confidential within the system.
Information Security: All information shared by Sunners will be kept confidential within the system.
Sharing Scope: All personnel and project information within the system is confidential. Sunners are requested to share only within Sun* internally.
Support Contact: For any questions, Sunners are welcome to contact the SAA Organizing Committee representative via Slack: duong.thi.thuy.an for assistance.
